title: Yochanan ben Narbai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A High Priest in the Second Temple. In [Pesachim 57a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.57a.10-11) they said of him that he was a glutton, and that in all his days no leftover [sacrificial meat] was found in the Temple.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Pesachim calls Yochanan ben Narbai a student of Pankai, describes his appetite and says that there were no leftovers in the Temple during his lifetime. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1809&lang=en) records the teacher and directs readers to his entry on Yochanan the High Priest.
